screening.method: Conservative, reproducible title/abstract triage with optional persistent editorial overrides.
screening.limitations: Automatic selection can miss relevant studies and include keyword matches; scientific novelty, validity, and speaker suitability require reading the paper.

ranking.parameter_basis: Heuristic configurable timescale; not empirically fitted to usage data.
ranking.formula: total_count / (-expm1(-age_days / exposure_tau_days)), where age_days=max(1, elapsed UTC days from first posting to the counter observation).
ranking.age_precision: Prefer the verified source-specific first-post timestamp; when only a date is available use midnight UTC and label age_basis accordingly.
ranking.interpretation: A model-based exposure correction of cumulative counts. Older papers approach their raw totals; younger papers receive a saturating exposure correction. This is not a measured final count or a per-day usage rate.
ranking.comparability: Source counters have different definitions. Rank measured papers within a source; missing counters are null and are never inferred from citations or platform totals.
